pages.text: The mixing bowl is a way of mixing items and fluids together in a friendly way. In order to operate a mixing bowl $(item)$(k:key.use)$() on one with a $(thing)Spoon$() to add it to the bowl. The spoon will remain in the bowl and not degrade in durability.

To use a mixing bowl add in your ingredients and $(item)$(k:key.use)$() it to begin mixing. Mixing bowls can take up to $(6)5 item inputs$() and $(3)1 fluid input$(). Recipes need $(n)exact quantities$() of items to be performed. If a recipe outputs a fluid any excess input fluids will be voided, so be careful!
